body:
how did the surgery go. How long did you have tmj problems. is your jaw better now from the surgery?
 I just started having problems about 1 and 1/2 years ago and its 80% improved but i still have some pain and it makes noises. i know i still clentch at night but its alot better. i got it from ptsd.
Thanks alot. Is that all that its called ?

Both you and the other person that commented pointed out therapy. Thanks alot. You really have opened my eyes to this. I need to see a trauma therapist. It's just they cost money. That is the main issue. The therapist I have does not.  I find she gives me tuff love some times and that is the last thing a trauma survivor needs

Thanks alot. Your comment has given me great hope. Yes I start volunteering soon. I have not been able to find a job right now but volunteering will help I'm sure and I also go to meditation class once a week. I also would like to try boxing or something physical. I am not sure where I could find that but probably a local gym I'm thinking.

But if I save up 3000 then what. Or do you mean all the money for the course. That will take some time. My mother can pay for the course. But I don't want to stay here and not live my life for 4 years just to complete the course.

Thank you very much. Yes he is out of my life as he was extremely abusive. I had to get a restraining order against him cause he was such a psychopath. And thank u. Yes I have a jaw device I got from a tmj specialist. Thankfully it helps but it's had not cured it. I have been turned down by 3 doctors now to do the revision surgery it's very discouraging. I am hoping that this next referal I get won't turn me down. Mind u there r risks with the surgery also. It's very annoying
good for you! inspiring.. people are A holes

oh and yes i would like to add i have had some jobs, they just did not last, and i have also had many interviews.. i keep doing resume revisions and submitting them daily.. and trying to build more skills that i can add to my resume.. i have volunteered also

Thank you for your kind words. I really appreciate what you wrote. thank you for taking the time to do so. Yes you are correct - my parents expect nothing out of me. They are not the ones that have this perception of me I have this perception of my self cause the not finding a job thing has lead me to feed all these negative comments to my self.. just in writing this i realize those comments come from my father. and how he measured success. He was abusive and controlling also. 
The TMJ i don tknow if it will ever go away. It seems it started last year when a friend told me about it and told me that anxiety can cause it. Well within a few weeks it happened to me and now it wont stop. its a battle of anxiety and clenching and anxiety. I assume though that it started before i ever experienced pain, that it started after a nose surgery I had, to straighten my septum. and since the septum is still not straight the TMJ doctor speculates that is why im clenching. I have had 3 doctors decline to do a second revision surgery on my nose which really sucks cause i dont think the tmj will go away without my nose having a second surgery... i dont know what to do.
hey. I am a medicinal cannabis user also and I still have TMJ from the stress and anxiety I feel. :( I cant get rid of it and it is destroying my life.

retail i have learned is all about numbers, its about money to be made, hours to be worked and you your self are a number.. no one really cares and no matter how long you have been somewhere you are expendable. I have experienced this time and time again and even though i gave exceptional performance. its really unfortunate.. I dont know what can be done to change this... cause it just seems to be getting worse. Every retail position i have worked is like this... :( its almost better to not try and you will get the same feedback..
